thread:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout for service=encoder env=prod canary=5% image=encoder:v2.3.4
infra-bot: Deploy started (ci-4321). Health checks will be monitored.
dan (oncall): paging: PROD - encoder canary failing (alerts firing). Acked.
infra-bot: Alert: pods/encoder-canary-xxxxx CrashLoopBackOff x6 in 3m. HPA scaled from 2 -> 0 -> 8 (oscillation).
alice: Seeing many restarts, looks like liveness probe failing on startup.
ben: Logs from pod: 
```
2026-03-17T12:03:21Z ERROR startup: model quant load took 38s
2026-03-17T12:03:21Z INFO liveness check failed (timeout 5s)
```
carla: The new warmup endpoint /_warmup is hit during preStart and we've tightened liveness timeout to 5s in v2.3.4 — startup can be 30s on cold model loads.
emily: Customers on encoder-backed endpoints showing 502 spike and latency 10x on a few orgs, support seeing tickets.
dan (oncall): Impact = partial: 5% canary, but downstream autoscaling caused spillover to other nodes. Initiating canary pause and mitigation.
frank: Recommend flip feature flag encoder_new_startup -> OFF (kill-switch) while we rollback. Who can flip?
alice: I can flip it now. Flag: features/encoder_new_startup = true -> false.
alice: Done. Flag toggled at 12:07 UTC :white_check_mark:.
infra-bot: Noted flag change, but existing pods still crash due to liveness probe interval. Suggest rollback to v2.3.3.
ben: Agreed. Rolling back canary to image=encoder:v2.3.3. Command: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/encoder encoder=registry/encoder:v2.3.3 --record`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated, canary set to previous image. Watching pods.
carla: Also increasing liveness timeout to 60s on canary pods to avoid immediate restarts while rollback completes: apply patch diff:
```
- livenessProbe:
-   httpGet: /healthz
-   timeoutSeconds: 5
+ livenessProbe:
+   httpGet: /healthz
+   timeoutSeconds: 60
```
dan (oncall): I'm coordinating with SRE to avoid node evictions during this churn. Temporarily suspending HPA scale-down (set minReplicas=2).
infra-bot: HPA minReplicas updated.
infra-bot: Rollback complete, new pods Running (v2.3.3). Alerts clearing.
emily: Support: customer error rate back to baseline for impacted orgs, will follow up with postmortem note.
frank: Thanks. Action items: 1) Revert liveness change in CI (do not tighten to 5s). 2) Add warmup in startup path or make probe check readiness endpoint. 3) Postmortem + customer comms.
dan (oncall): Handoff to next oncall at 12:30 UTC. I'll start the incident ticket and tag SRE/eng leads.
infra-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0317-encoder-canary.
carla: Dropping short runbook snippet for future: "If encoder canary CrashLoopBackOff after deploy: pause rollout, toggle encoder_new_startup flag, rollback image, increase liveness timeout, suspend HPA min reduction."
ben: Will follow up with a small fix PR to change the liveness to use readinessProbe + longer timeout.
date-bot: Deploy metrics: CPU and restart_count normalizing after rollback.
frank: Moving to postmortem. Thanks everyone. :pray:
